pool_rule: Split by each clipper's share of approved views when the marathon ends; 750K total views to share the pool (campaign page Nov 19; the Nov 12 article said 1M).
required_in_caption: LACY's name in the caption or text overlay
rules: Source: any stream, video or clip featuring Lacy during his GTA marathon, from November 18, 2026.
Lacy must be the primary focus, in the actual edit (not only the intro).
Platforms: TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and X only.
Audience at least 50% from native English-speaking countries (USA, CA, AU, UK, NZ): English captions and on-screen text, no non-target slang.
Posting account must be in a related niche (gaming/GTA/streamer clips is fine).
Caption or text overlay must mention LACY's name; caption must use #LACY.
Only approved videos count; must reach the total view requirement (750K approved views) to share the pool.
Never portray Lacy negatively; no hate farming or false negative narratives (rejection or ban).
No view or engagement manipulation of any kind: botting, reposts, collab posts.
NO LOGOS OF ANY KIND: no Vice Replay logo/watermark, no channel badges, no game or brand logos.
No repetitive or non-matching thumbnails; no Japanese captions/descriptions.
Look for: funny moments, memorable quotes, reactions and memorable moments from the marathon.
Submit each clip in Content Rewards within 30 minutes of posting (Whop account verified with connected socials).
One strike and you're out: botting, AI-generated content or gaming the system. Real footage only, no AI voice/visuals.
Reach recommends a dedicated LACY clipping account (e.g. LACYClips) unless the account is a relevant clip page with 100+ followers.
source_footage: Lacy's GTA 6 marathon stream replays on his YouTube channel (UCeoZXkaJDtdTHafgoZeDcAA; he streams on twitch.tv/lacy), plus any stream/video/clip featuring Lacy during the marathon from Nov 18.
notes: Crowded pool (Reach GTA 6 pools: 502 clippers). Low priority vs KreekCraft. No logos: don't add any Vice Replay branding to these clips. Owner (Nov 19): use Everygen but be careful with credits: search one stretch (max 1 hour), finish at most 2 clips per batch, report credits spent; the free Drive inbox (studio.campaign_inbox) stays as backup. Day 1 VODs are longer than Everygen find_clips' 8-hour limit: search one stretch (e.g. the first hour) instead. Pool needs 750K approved views across OUR clips to get any share: realistic only with a big account.
audience_min_tier1: 50% from USA, Canada, Australia, UK, New Zealand

Then set them UNLISTED (not private, not deleted): links keep working for any payout audit, they stop shaping Vice Replay's public identity, and they don't stay in public view under a campaign permission that has ended. Re-check if the dashboard shows any rule requiring them to stay public longer.
